maddeler.e:
أتأمرك (form IIq)
# أَتَأَمْرَكُ (ʔataʔamraku) /ʔa.ta.ʔam.ra.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# أَتَأَمْرَكَ (ʔataʔamraka) /ʔa.ta.ʔam.ra.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# أَتَأَمْرَكْ (ʔataʔamrak) /ʔa.ta.ʔam.rak/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
